title: The Delivery Robot That Kept Coming Back
central_conflict: a small delivery robot returned to the same doorstep with every parcel
decisive_choice: two destinations had been assigned one identical route identifier
resolution: gave each destination a distinct identifier and checked the full delivery route
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered a small delivery robot returned to the same doorstep with every parcel before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but they cleaned its wheels but it completed the same mistaken route; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized two destinations had been assigned one identical route identifier; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.

With the visiting readers watching, they gave each destination a distinct identifier and checked the full delivery route, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Tickets Nobody Could Read
central_conflict: the school fair's winning ticket numbers vanished under the festival lights
decisive_choice: a colored filter over the stage lamps made the ticket ink blend into the paper
resolution: read the originals under neutral lamps and printed high-contrast replacements
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the school fair's winning ticket numbers vanished under the festival lights before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.

title: The Concert Hall That Swallowed Music
central_conflict: the new concert hall sounded strangely quiet even with a full orchestra
decisive_choice: temporary sound-absorbing rehearsal curtains covered the reflective wall panels
resolution: repositioned the curtains with the hall crew and checked sound from every row
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, rabbit and fox discovered the new concert hall sounded strangely quiet even with a full orchestra before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit attempted an immediate fix, but the players performed louder but listeners at the back still heard almost nothing; fox stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Fox examined the evidence and realized temporary sound-absorbing rehearsal curtains covered the reflective wall panels; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the visiting readers watching, they repositioned the curtains with the hall crew and checked sound from every row, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
